# awscc_ses_receipt_filter (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::SES::ReceiptFilter



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `filter` (Attributes) A structure that describes the IP address filter to create, which consists of a name, an IP address range, and whether to allow or block mail from it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter))
- `receipt_filter_id` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Read-Only:

- `ip_filter` (Attributes) A structure that provides the IP addresses to block or allow, and whether to block or allow incoming mail from them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filter--ip_filter))
- `name` (String) The name of the IP address filter.

<a id="nestedatt--filter--ip_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter.ip_filter`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) A single IP address or a range of IP addresses to block or allow, specified in CIDR notation.
- `policy` (String) Indicates whether to block or allow incoming mail from the specified IP addresses.
